points.quote: `packages/frontend/` is everything the user sees: ... `packages/backend/` has two parts ... `packages/common/` holds shared libraries
`tools/` has the CLI (`yarn affine`), the changelog, commitlint and utility scripts. ... `tests/` for end-to-end tests.
`blocksuite/` is the editor engine, with its own packages

`web` is the browser app. `electron` and `electron-renderer` are the desktop app. `mobile` and `mobile-shared` are the mobile web UI, packaged as native apps by `ios` and `android`. ... `admin` is a separate admin web app.
`native` and `mobile-native` are the native bindings. ... The Rust native binding, built with `yarn affine @affine/server-native build`.
Local-first clients can work without it. The server is what enables cloud sync, collaboration, AI and self-hosting.
PostgreSQL, set with `DATABASE_URL` ... Redis, set with the `REDIS_SERVER_*` variables ... It exposes a GraphQL endpoint (`/graphql`)
